name: Glasslock Tempered Glass Set
description: Glasslock 18-piece tempered glass food storage set. The brand states the containers are tempered glass and the lids are polypropylene with a silicone gasket. The brand page checked does not say PFAS-free.
features: Glasslock's US page says the glass is made from silica, soda ash, limestone, and other natural components, that the containers are tempered glass, and that the lids are polypropylene.
That page says the products are BPA-free. A replacement-parts answer on the same page refers to silicone gaskets in the lids.

The Amazon listing title for ASIN B07QPQGNF3 says the 18-piece set (nine containers and nine latching lids) is oven safe to 450°F. The brand page checked does not print that temperature. Take the lid off before the oven.
The brand page does not use the word PFAS. This directory has not tested the glass or the lid.
labelNote: The polypropylene lid and silicone gasket are separate from the tempered glass body. The brand does not say PFAS-free on the page checked here.
